name: Mukō (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Mukō city emblem in white: a stylised chrysanthemum of twelve petals enclosing a ring with a hexagon.
history: Municipal flag of Mukō, a city in Kyoto Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 October 1982.

features.role: Mukō city emblem — a stylised chrysanthemum of twelve petals enclosing a ring with a hexagon
